title: Veterans Pension Recurring Income — Cost-of-Living Raise of the Veteran's Social Security
content:
When the recurring countable income on a Veterans Pension award is redetermined, a veteran's Social Security figure whose benefit level took effect 24 or more whole months before the redetermination is raised by the two most recent December cost-of-living increases together; one that took effect 12 to 23 whole months before is raised by the most recent December increase; one under 12 whole months old is used as reported. The raised figure is rounded to the cent.

The age is the whole months from the date the benefit level took effect, shown on the veteran's most recent Social Security report, to the redetermination.

| Age of the benefit level | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 24 whole months or more | 1.0537 (both December increases together) |
| 12 to 23 whole months | 1.028 (the most recent December increase) |
| under 12 whole months | 1 (as reported) |

**Hypothetical figure of 15000.00:** under 12 months, 15000.00; at 12 to 23 months, 15420.00; at 24 months or more, 15805.50.
